info.description: Premier League ticketing account manager. Every response uses the { data, meta, error } envelope. Money is an integer of minor units plus a currency code, never a float. Dates are ISO-8601 UTC strings; the client formats, the server never does. Generated from the Zod schemas in lib/api/schemas.ts.

get.description:
THE PIECE NOT TO GET WRONG.

- Returns ONLY events with seq STRICTLY GREATER than `since`. Not >=. A client that echoes back the cursor it was given must receive nothing, or it re-reads the same row forever.
- In order, ascending by seq.
- `meta.lastSeq` is the seq of the LAST EVENT IN THIS RESPONSE, not the run's high-water mark. Returning the high-water mark while truncating at `limit` would skip everything in between.
- When nothing is new: `data` is [] and `lastSeq` is unchanged. THE CURSOR NEVER GOES BACKWARDS.
- `meta.hasMore` is true when the run holds events past `lastSeq`.

The client never deduplicates. If it has to, this endpoint lied. A page reload starts from since=0 and replays the whole run, which is why events are kept rather than trimmed.

Poll every 1000 ms while the run is live, plus ONE final call once it is terminal.

get.description: A FILE, not the envelope — it is a download. There is no password column, ever: this file leaves the machine.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Opaque string id. Never assume numeric or sequential.

lastSeq.description: Cursor for the next call. The seq of the LAST EVENT IN THIS RESPONSE, not the run's high-water mark. Set only by GET /ballots/runs/{id}/events.

hasMore.description: True when the run holds events past lastSeq, so a client that has fallen behind can call again immediately. Events endpoint only.

BallotClubId.description: The seven clubs the ballot module supports. A SUBSET of ClubId, not a parallel union — a ballot account is an ordinary Account whose club happens to be one of these.

ImapAccount.description: A mailbox a profile with otpSource "imap" can read two-factor codes from.

delayMinMs.description: Shortest pause between two tasks on the same worker.

delayMaxMs.description: The gap is drawn uniformly from [delayMinMs, delayMaxMs]. Must be >= delayMinMs.

imapId.description: Required when otpSource is "imap"; must name a mailbox from GET /ballots/imap.

stopOnRateLimit.description: A 429 ends the run instead of carrying on.

BallotProfileInput.description: The writable half of a profile. Two rules are enforced server-side, not in the form: delayMinMs <= delayMaxMs, and imapId is required when otpSource is "imap".

delayMinMs.description: Shortest pause between two tasks on the same worker.

delayMaxMs.description: The gap is drawn uniformly from [delayMinMs, delayMaxMs]. Must be >= delayMinMs.

imapId.description: Required when otpSource is "imap"; must name a mailbox from GET /ballots/imap.

stopOnRateLimit.description: A 429 ends the run instead of carrying on.

label.description: Domain data. Rendered verbatim, never snake_cased.

profileName.description: Denormalised on purpose: renaming a profile must not rewrite the history of a run that already happened.

etaSeconds.description: Absent on a terminal run or before anything has been attempted.

lastEventSeq.description: High-water mark of the run's event stream.

accountEmail.description: Denormalised so the table needs no second request.

lastMessage.description: A short readable sentence, never a stack trace. A code is not an explanation.

entryRef.description: The club's entry reference, on success.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per run, append-only. THIS IS THE CURSOR.

code.description: SUBMITTED, OTP_REQUIRED, RATE_LIMITED, PROXY_DEAD, ENTRY_CONFIRMED, UPSTREAM_ERROR, …

message.description: The readable half. Never carries a "//" prefix.

text.description: One "email:password" per line. "," and ";" are accepted as separators too. Sent ONCE and never stored client-side.

skipped.description: Lines repeated within the pasted block itself.

row.description: 1-based line number in the operator's own paste.

PasteResult.description: Never echoes a password back, in any field.

accountIds.description: Explicit account ids. OMIT to mean every eligible account in clubIds, resolved server-side at start.

label.description: Optional. Defaults to the clubs plus the start time.
